import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
input_dir = "./input"
submission_dir = "./submission"
train_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv")
test_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv")
sample_sub_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission.csv")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Check class distribution (diagnostic)
print("\nCover_Type distribution:")
print(train_df["Cover_Type"].value_counts().sort_index())

# Feature and target columns
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in [id_col, target_col]]

X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df[target_col]
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

print(f"\nFeature count: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Use random split instead of stratified (stratification fails with class 5 having 1 member)
val_size = 0.15
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=val_size, random_state=42
)

print(
    f"\nSplit sizes - Train: {len(X_tr)}, Validation: {len(X_val)}, Test: {len(X_test)}"
)

# Add some simple feature engineering with proper z-score standardization
print("\nFeature engineering...")
for X in [X_tr, X_val, X_train, X_test]:
    X = X.copy()
    for col in X.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns:
        if X[col].std() > 0:
            X[col] = (X[col] - X[col].mean()) / X[col].std()

# Train LightGBM classifier (parameters optimized for 3M+ samples)
print("\nTraining LightGBM classifier...")
model = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=12,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=31,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
)

model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
print("\nEvaluating on validation set...")
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Class distribution in predictions
print(f"\nPrediction distribution:")
print(pd.Series(y_val_pred).value_counts().sort_index())

# Generate predictions on test set
print("\nGenerating test predictions...")
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file (preserving original format exactly)
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_df[id_col], "Cover_Type": y_test_pred})

# Save submission
output_path = os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {output_path}")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")

# Verify submission
print("\nSubmission preview (first 10 rows):")
print(submission_df.head(10))
print("\nSubmission preview (last 10 rows):")
print(submission_df.tail(10))
print("\nSubmission class distribution:")
print(submission_df["Cover_Type"].value_counts().sort_index())
